title: AuricSpawners - Silk Touch
description: Remove normal and trial spawners with Silk Touch and customize the item obtained!
body:
# 🌟 AuricSpawners - The Ultimate Spawner Mining Experience
**AuricSpawners** it is a plugin that allows mining spawners with different levels of silk touch or permissions, characterized by allowing the mining of trial chamber spawners, in addition to being highly customizable.

## ✨ Key Features
* **Advanced Silk Touch Mechanics:** Require Silk Touch to mine spawners and even set a **minimum enchantment level** (perfect if your server has custom enchants!).
* **1.21 Trial Spawner Support:** Fully supports the new Trial Spawners! Using an intelligent Reflection system, it detects the specific mob from the wave configuration, saves it to the item, and perfectly restores it when placed.
* **Dynamic Mob Detection:** Customize your dropped spawner items using the `%mob%` placeholder. The plugin automatically detects the entity type and formats it beautifully.
* **Hex Colors & MiniMessage:** Create stunning visuals with RGB gradients and modern text formatting for your items and plugin messages.
* **Smart Version Compatibility:** Thanks to its detection system, the plugin works correctly in all versions above 1.18 without being affected by new mobs, because it scans the mob name and can recognize it even when the new versions have just been released.
* **Fully Toggleable Restrictions:** Want players to need a specific permission to mine or place spawners? You can easily toggle these requirements in the configuration.

## ⚙️ Commands
* `/auricspawners reload` - Reloads the configuration and messages. *(auricspawners.admin)*

## 👑 Permissions
* `auricspawners.mine` - Allows the player to break spawners and get the drop (Only required if `require-mine-permission` is set to true in config).
* `auricspawners.place` - Allows the player to place spawners back on the ground (Only required if `require-place-permission` is set to true in config).
* `auricspawners.admin` - Grants access to the reload command and receives in-game notifications when a new update is available.
